inputs.text: More tenancies mean little when families are still facing eviction and homelessness. The real failure is a housing system that leaves families without security while government reaches for more regulation and celebrates statistics. Six-year lease rules introduced on March 1 may sound reassuring, but owners need confidence to provide homes, not ever more interference. Stable homes matter for family life and social order; the government should be judged by whether people can stay housed, not by a flattering headline.

output.main_topic: Housing insecurity and criticism of government housing policy
